drift_items.note: Only ERROR/ERROR_OCCURRED and PARAMETER_CHANGE/PARAMETER_CHANGED have clear semantic mappings. The two taxonomies reflect different design philosophies: docs describe a multi-agent tutorial system; shipped code models a ReAct agent loop.
Docs describe a multi-method recorder (record_task_plan, record_collaborators, etc.) while shipped code uses a single record(event) method with workflow-partitioned JSONL storage.

Docs reference TaskPlan, PlanStep, AgentInfo, ParameterSubstitution, ExecutionTrace, RecordedEvent — none of which exist in shipped code. Shipped code uses only EventType, TraceEvent, and BlackBoxRecorder.
